skill.learned.text: Done. Remember the feel, not the name.

skill.tutor_deny.speaker: Greybeard
skill.tutor_deny.text: Gold, or you're already at the top.

soul.equipped.speaker: System
soul.equipped.text: Soul set. The blade's temper has changed.

soul.ritual_not_enough.speaker: Starreader
soul.ritual_not_enough.text: Not enough stardust to light a corner.

soul.fused.speaker: Starreader
soul.fused.text: Three on one track, merged into a brighter star.

soul.fuse_requirement.speaker: Starreader

forge.need_rusty_first.speaker: Ding
forge.need_rusty_first.text: Let me look at that rusty iron of yours first.

forge.path_chosen.speaker: System
forge.path_chosen.text: Draw souls at the Soul Hall. Power {power}.

forge.wood_sword_no_gold.speaker: Ding
forge.wood_sword_no_gold.text: Twenty gold. No money, no hogging my forge.

forge.wood_sword_owned.speaker: Ding
forge.wood_sword_owned.text: A wooden sword? You already got one.

forge.tier_max.speaker: Ding
forge.tier_max.text: Enough. Go cut the lion first.

forge.no_gold.speaker: Ding
forge.no_gold.text: Where's the gold? Take a walk outside the walls.

forge.pity_break.speaker: Ding
forge.pity_break.text: (Slams the hammer on the anvil) Enough! The iron has more patience than you!

forge.pity_break.speaker: System
forge.pity_break.text: The hammer lands by the forge; sparks scatter.

forge.pity_break.speaker: System
forge.pity_break.text: Some stamina recovered. Losing streak reset.

forge.failed.speaker: Ding
forge.failed.text: Failed. Tier stays. Materials are gone.
